# XFree

> Browser-based developer, SEO, and AI micro-tools with explicit live/draft capability controls.

Live site: https://www.xfree.in
Repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/xfree

## Production stack
- React 19
- TypeScript
- Vite 6
- Express 4
- Tailwind 4
- Zod
- Vercel serverless + prerendered static HTML

## Implemented surfaces
- Interactive developer/SEO/browser tools
- Published guides
- PWA install surface
- Server-side Gemini AI gateway
- NVIDIA NIM cloud-mode gateway with task routing and fallback
- Contact/feedback/lead endpoints with validation and rate limiting
- Prerendered SEO metadata and structured data
- Sitemap, robots.txt, llms.txt generation, and IndexNow
- Security headers and server-side API-key handling

## Important limits
- Do not claim 400+ working tools.
- Draft seed-registry entries are not live tools and are excluded from public indexing.
- next-app/ is an undeployed Next.js rewrite; it is not the production site.
- Optional AI features require configured provider credentials.
- In-memory rate limiting should be replaced with a durable store before real traffic.
